rules.statement: A father may revoke a gift to his children, even without assigning a just cause, according to Shafei law.
rules.supporting_quote: "With respect to the tradition of the Prophet quoted by Shafei, the meaning of it is that the donor is not himself empowered to retract his gift, as this must be done by decree of the Kazee with the consent of the donor, excepting in the case of a father, who is himself competent to retract a gift to his son when he wants it for the maintenance of the son."
